# CrackFlow Full Technical & Product Specification

## Executive Summary
CrackFlow is a native desktop artificial intelligence copilot created specifically for job candidates undergoing real-time technical, behavioral, and system design interviews. Unlike generic web chatbots or browser extensions, CrackFlow runs directly on the candidate's operating system (Windows / macOS), capturing low-latency system audio, processing natural language queries with tailored LLM models, and displaying concise answer blueprints inside a private, hardware-accelerated desktop overlay.

---

## Complete Feature Matrix

### 1. Real-Time Audio Capture & Transcription
- Intercepts system audio output (interviewer's voice) and candidate microphone input simultaneously.
- Employs streaming speech-to-text models optimized for technical jargon, programming syntax, and accent resiliency.
- Latency target: Sub-second audio chunk processing.

### 2. CrackFlow Code Engine
- Tailored for live technical rounds on LeetCode, HackerRank, CodeSignal, and CoderPad.
- Analyzes problem statements, constraints, and edge cases.
- Produces clean code snippets, algorithmic explanations, and explicit Big-O time and space complexity evaluations.

### 3. CrackFlow Personal Context Grounding
- Allows candidates to upload PDF/Text versions of their Resume, Portfolio, and target Job Description prior to an interview.
- Embeds context using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
- Ensures behavioral answers (e.g. STAR method responses) incorporate the candidate's real job history, metrics, and accomplishments rather than generic AI responses.

### 4. Discreet Overlay Architecture & Privacy Guarantee
- Native window rendered with OS-level flags (`WS_EX_TRANSPARENT`, `WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE` on Windows).
- Completely invisible to screen-sharing applications such as Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex.
- Keyboard-only navigation (`Ctrl+Enter` to request assist, `Ctrl+B` to show/hide, arrow keys to scroll).

## Full FAQ Knowledgebase

1. **What is CrackFlow?**
   CrackFlow is a native desktop AI copilot that listens to your interview conversation in real time and provides concise, context-aware answers — without your interviewer ever knowing it's there.

2. **How does CrackFlow work?**
   CrackFlow captures audio from your system, transcribes the conversation, understands the question using AI, and delivers a structured response in your private overlay — all in seconds.

3. **Does CrackFlow support coding interviews?**
   Yes. CrackFlow Code mode handles DSA problems, debugging, time/space complexity analysis, and system design questions on platforms like LeetCode, HackerRank, and CodeSignal.

4. **Can CrackFlow understand my resume and job description?**
   Yes. CrackFlow Context lets you load your resume, project descriptions, and the job description so responses are grounded in your personal experience.

5. **Does CrackFlow work with Zoom and Google Meet?**
   CrackFlow works alongside any video meeting platform that runs on your desktop, including Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Webex.

6. **Does CrackFlow support HackerRank and LeetCode?**
   Yes. CrackFlow can assist during coding assessments on HackerRank, LeetCode, CodeSignal, and CoderPad.

7. **How fast does CrackFlow respond?**
   CrackFlow is designed for low-latency assistance during live interviews. Response times depend on your network and question complexity.

8. **How does CrackFlow handle interview context?**
   You can preload context documents before your interview. CrackFlow uses this context alongside real-time transcription to generate relevant answers.

9. **Is CrackFlow a browser extension?**
   No. CrackFlow is a native desktop application, which allows it to capture system audio and maintain a private overlay separate from your browser or meeting app.

10. **Does CrackFlow support different response styles?**
    Yes. You can switch between concise bullet-point responses, detailed explanations, and code-first responses depending on what the question requires.

11. **Can I use CrackFlow with a second device?**
    Yes. You can run CrackFlow on a secondary device while your primary device runs the interview — a common setup for added discretion.

12. **Does CrackFlow offer mock interviews?**
    Yes. CrackFlow Mock lets you practice with structured AI-driven mock sessions and receive feedback on your answers.

13. **Does CrackFlow work on Windows and macOS?**
    CrackFlow currently supports Windows. macOS support is in active development.

14. **How is CrackFlow different from other AI interview assistants?**
    CrackFlow is built as a native desktop app with keyboard-first controls, context loading, and a private overlay — designed for the actual interview experience, not just practice.

15. **Do CrackFlow credits expire?**
    Credit expiry details are available on the Pricing page. Please check before purchasing.

16. **Does CrackFlow require a credit card?**
    A free trial is available. Credit card requirements depend on the plan you select.

17. **Can I cancel my subscription?**
    Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account dashboard. See our Terms for details.

18. **Where can I get support?**
    You can reach the CrackFlow support team via the Contact page or by emailing support@crackflow.in.
